slug: 2025-07-01 MTN launches West Africa's largest Tier III data centre with cloud services (Techpoint)

facts.fact: MTN Nigeria launched the Sifiso Dabengwa Data Centre in Lagos on 1 July 2025 (phase 1 4.5MW, 9MW planned in total) with a cloud service sold to Nigerian businesses and startups.
MTN Nigeria describes the Sifiso Dabengwa Data Centre as West Africa's largest Tier III data centre, launched 1 July 2025 (operator's description; no certifier named).

note: carried from datacentres; no document opened
